summary: Degree/weight bookkeeping for (5,8) is confirmed: d=20, ordinary open input W_24 H^24(M_5,8) of expected Tate type Q(-12). Under the forgetful map M_5,8→M_5,7 the fibre is a 7-punctured genus-five curve, so the residual local system R^1:=R^1 π_* Q is mixed of weights 1 and 2 (weight-one standard symplectic summand plus weight-two puncture quotient). The pure-weight residual package is therefore the full graded piece Gr^W_24 H^23(M_5,7;R^1), not the pure weight-one group Gr^W_24 H^23(M_5,7;H) proposed in ATT-0010/MRQ-0001; that earlier residual was formulated incorrectly by dropping the weight-two summand. After searching the five seed sources (arXiv versions through their corpus check dates, with survey SRC-0001 current as of 2026-05-19 and rechecked 2026-07-30) and their in-corpus forward citations to local-system literature, no published theorem computes, forces Tate type for, or proves vanishing of Gr^W_24 H^23(M_5,7;R^1), nor of its weight-one or weight-two graded pieces separately. Available theorems give only constant-coefficient purity on M_5,7 (CKgP, n<=7) and a general reduction of pure-weight open cohomology to symplectic local systems on M_g; Euler/point-count/semisimple substitutes are rejected.
unresolved: No locator-level computation of Gr^W_24 H^23(M_5,7;R^1) as a mixed Hodge structure.

No separate Hodge-structure determination of H^23(M_5,7;Gr^W_1 R^1) (weight-one symplectic) or H^22/H^23 pieces with Gr^W_2 R^1 (weight-two puncture quotient) that would force the weight-24 package to be Tate.
Constant-coefficient CKgP on M_5,7 and Lemma 3.1 do not upgrade to non-constant R^1 at virtual top degree 23=vcd(M_5,7).
Global degree-16 pure Tate for Mbar remains open (SRC-0001, May 2026); the (5,8) residual is one RED-0001 obstruction and is not removed by current literature.
